description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt project, specifically for platform-specific upgrade procedures for the ramips/rt288x target. It defines functions to check and perform firmware upgrades based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image. Currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade procedure based on the board name, delegating to default_do_upgrade for unspecified boards.
